'''Elite Ripptusk''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|An elite Landbreaker warbeast enhanced by fumes known as hazefyre. This particular ripptusk is more ferocious and cunning, and attacks with less predictable moves.}}

==Overview==
[[Bonekrusher Ripptusk]]s enhanced by hazefyre, Elite Ripptusks have similar appearance to their counterpart, but it doesn't make them more of a threat; They still attack with a bite or a leaping bite, which deals Physical damage.
